import primitive_api as api

ctx = api.get_task_context()
obs = api.observe()
print("Context:", ctx)
print("Pose:", obs.get("agent"))
print("Visible objects:", [o.get("objectId") for o in obs.get("visible_objects", [])])

scan = api.scan_scene(queries=["Fridge", "Cabinet", "Drawer", "CounterTop", "SaltShaker"], rotations=4, include_tilts=True)
print("Scan query hits:", {k: [x.get("objectId") for x in v] for k, v in scan.get("query_hits", {}).items()})
print("Progress:", api.check_progress_public())

    r = api.move_ahead()

        print(f"Walk 1 stopped at {i}: {r}")
        break
    # Also check if Fridge is visible and close
    vis = api.detect_objects("Fridge")

        print(f"Reached fridge at step {i}, dist={vis[0]['distance']}")
        break

obs_fridge = api.inspect_current_view(label="at_fridge")
print("At fridge pose:", obs_fridge["observation"]["agent"])

# Check all remembered cabinets and drawers so far
print("Remembered cabinets:", [(o["objectId"], o.get("position")) for o in api.recall_visible_objects("Cabinet")])
print("Remembered drawers:", [(o["objectId"], o.get("position")) for o in api.recall_visible_objects("Drawer")])
print("Remembered all types:", set(o["objectType"] for o in api.recall_visible_objects()))

# Look down more to see the cabinet below the kitchen counter
api.look("down")
obs_down2 = api.inspect_current_view(label="at_counter_down2")
print("Down 2 pose:", obs_down2["observation"]["agent"])
print("Visible down 2:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in obs_down2["visible_objects"]])

api.look("down")
obs_down3 = api.inspect_current_view(label="at_counter_down3")
print("Down 3 pose:", obs_down3["observation"]["agent"])
print("Visible down 3:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in obs_down3["visible_objects"]])

# Look for any lower Cabinet (y < 1.0)
cabs = [o for o in api.detect_objects("Cabinet") if o["position"]["y"] < 1.0]
print("Visible lower cabinets:", cabs)
if cabs:
    cab_id = cabs[0]["objectId"]
    open_res = api.open_object(cab_id)
    print("Open cab result:", open_res.get("valid_action"), open_res.get("error"))
    obs_after_open = api.inspect_current_view(label="after_open_cab")
    print("Visible after open:", [o["objectId"] for o in obs_after_open["visible_objects"]])
    salts = api.detect_objects("SaltShaker")
    print("Salts visible:", salts)
    if salts:
        pick_res = api.pickup_object(salts[0]["objectId"])
        print("Pick salt result:", pick_res.get("valid_action"), pick_res.get("error"))
        api.close_object(cab_id)

print("Inventory:", api.query_inventory())
print("Progress:", api.check_progress_public())

# We are at (x=0.25, z=-2.0), rotation y=90.0, cameraHorizon=60.0.
# The drawers are at x=0.64, z=-0.65:
# 'Drawer|+00.64|+00.76|-00.65' (top, y=0.76)
# 'Drawer|+00.64|+00.55|-00.65' (second, y=0.55)
# 'Drawer|+00.64|+00.27|-00.65' (bottom, y=0.27)
# Let's turn left (to y=0.0, facing +z), walk 5 steps to z=-0.75, and turn right (to y=90.0, facing +x).

api.look("up")  # horizon 45
api.rotate("left")  # y=0.0
for _ in range(5):
    api.move_ahead()
api.rotate("right")  # y=90.0

obs_drawers = api.inspect_current_view(label="at_drawers")
print("At drawers pose:", obs_drawers["observation"]["agent"])
print("Visible drawers:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"], o["position"]) for o in api.detect_objects("Drawer")])

# Target is the second pullout drawer: Drawer|+00.64|+00.55|-00.65
target_drawer = "Drawer|+00.64|+00.55|-00.65"
vis_drawers = {o["objectId"]: o for o in api.detect_objects("Drawer")}
if target_drawer not in vis_drawers:
    api.look("down")
    obs_drawers = api.inspect_current_view(label="at_drawers_down")
    vis_drawers = {o["objectId"]: o for o in api.detect_objects("Drawer")}
    print("Visible drawers after look down:", list(vis_drawers.keys()))

if target_drawer in vis_drawers:
    o_res = api.open_object(target_drawer)
    print("Open drawer:", o_res.get("valid_action"), o_res.get("error"))
    inv = api.query_inventory()
    if inv:
        salt_id = inv[0]["objectId"]
        p_res = api.put_object(salt_id, target_drawer)
        print("Put salt in drawer:", p_res.get("valid_action"), p_res.get("error"))
        c_res = api.close_object(target_drawer)
        print("Close drawer:", c_res.get("valid_action"), c_res.get("error"))

obs_final = api.inspect_current_view(label="final_view")
print("Check success:", api.check_success())
print("Check progress:", api.check_progress_public())

# The drawer failed to open because we are too close (x=0.25, distance=0.534) or held object is colliding.
# Let's step back one grid cell to x=0.0, z=-0.75 facing y=90.0.
api.rotate("left")   # y=0
api.rotate("left")   # y=270 (facing -x)
r_back = api.move_ahead()  # move to x=0.0
api.rotate("right")  # y=0
api.rotate("right")  # y=90 (facing +x)

obs_back = api.inspect_current_view(label="stepped_back")
print("Stepped back pose:", obs_back["observation"]["agent"])
print("Visible drawers:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"], o["isOpen"]) for o in api.detect_objects("Drawer")])

target_drawer = "Drawer|+00.64|+00.55|-00.65"
o_res = api.open_object(target_drawer)
print("Open drawer from x=0.0:", o_res.get("valid_action"), o_res.get("error"))

if not o_res.get("valid_action"):
    # Try looking down or up if needed, or moving to z=-0.5
    api.look("down")
    o_res = api.open_object(target_drawer)
    print("Open drawer after look down:", o_res.get("valid_action"), o_res.get("error"))

if o_res.get("valid_action"):
    inv = api.query_inventory()
    if inv:
        salt_id = inv[0]["objectId"]
        p_res = api.put_object(salt_id, target_drawer)
        print("Put salt:", p_res.get("valid_action"), p_res.get("error"))
        c_res = api.close_object(target_drawer)
        print("Close drawer:", c_res.get("valid_action"), c_res.get("error"))

obs_done = api.inspect_current_view(label="done_view")
print("Check success:", api.check_success())
print("Check progress:", api.check_progress_public())
